walkthrough.title: Welcome to Pancho
walkthrough.description: Extension to clean and format text like Notepad++
walkthrough.step.menu.title: Context menu
walkthrough.step.menu.description: Right-click in the editor to see Pancho's menu with all commands organized by category.
walkthrough.step.categories.title: Available categories
walkthrough.step.categories.description:
- **Edit**: Clean spaces and line breaks
- **Lines**: Sort, reverse, remove duplicates
- **Case**: Convert text
- **Indentation**: Convert between tabs and spaces
- **Encoding**: Base64, URL, HTML entities
- **Formatting**: JSON, HTML, CSS, JS, SQL, XML
- **Hash & binary**: MD5, SHA-256, conversions
walkthrough.step.keybindings.title: Keyboard shortcuts
walkthrough.step.keybindings.description:
Pancho includes keyboard shortcuts for the most common operations:
- `Ctrl+Shift+U`: Uppercase
- `Ctrl+Shift+L`: Lowercase
- `Ctrl+Shift+T`: Trim lines
- `Ctrl+Shift+W`: Count words

See the full list in the settings.
walkthrough.step.settings.title: Settings
walkthrough.step.settings.description:
Customize Pancho's behavior in Settings > Extensions > Pancho:
- Tab size
- Default end of line
- Show counters in status bar
